authority.rule: Specific named race, manufacturer, vessel, installation, or technology canon outranks this comparative layer. This registry compares established families; it does not assign ownership, prevalence, dates, inventors, or universal numeric constants.

families.name: Metric Compression Envelope
families.gravity_behavior: Strong gradients and curvature increase deformation, sensing, and structural burden; tolerance depends on field authority and prediction quality.
families.signature_profile: distributed field deformation, power/thermal transients, gravimetric disturbance
families.failure_character: field asymmetry, horizon/recovery deficit, structural overrun
families.scaling_character: nonlinear with protected volume, field surface, timing span, structure, and recovery reserve
families.recovery_character: continuous field unwind and controlled de-transit

families.name: Gravitational-Plane Skimmer
families.physical_action: 4D geodesic-plane transit with higher-order gradient correction
families.gravity_behavior: Gravity is both usable terrain and hazard; gradients, tides, shear forks, and hidden higher-dimensional terrain require route prediction rather than simple avoidance.
families.signature_profile: gravimetric coupling, route-following corrections, recoupling events
families.failure_character: branch ambiguity, divergent shear solution, differential vessel coupling
families.scaling_character: strongly affected by sensor baseline, structural coherence, sectional coupling, and terrain-model covariance
derived_selection_strengths: low brute-force field demand on favorable terrain

families.name: Hyperspatial Slipstream Shear
families.gravity_behavior: Gravity and higher-dimensional terrain alter Q-boundary geometry, weather, exit correspondence, and shear stability without making this a gravitic-plane system.
families.signature_profile: Q-boundary adhesion, wake disturbance, detach/exit transient
families.failure_character: adhesion loss, Q-weather front, boundary curvature pinch, wake resonance
families.scaling_character: whole-hull adhesion authority, sensor lookahead, sector timing, wake interaction, and detach reserve scale nonlinearly
derived_selection_strengths: wake exploitation at mature Path levels
derived_selection_weaknesses: safe exit geometry is a first-class constraint

families.name: Q-Lattice Phase Translation
families.gravity_behavior: Gravity contributes to address/epoch uncertainty and reference error rather than acting as a simple drag coefficient.
families.signature_profile: address lock, phase-clock activity, discrete translation transient
families.failure_character: address alias, epoch miss, coverage hole, clock split, destination conflict
families.scaling_character: protected-state coverage, clock coherence, address solution complexity, and state-buffer burden dominate
families.recovery_character: reject invalid future state or recover from incomplete/failed translation state
derived_selection_strengths: strong compatibility with indexed navigation infrastructure

families.name: N-Dimensional Manifold Drive
families.gravity_behavior: Gravity conditions embedding and return-map stability; ordinary-space neighbors can have unrelated manifold routes.
families.signature_profile: embedding-field activity, topology/axis control, re-embedding transient
families.failure_character: axis inversion, hidden higher-dimensional obstacle, return-map corruption, topology change
families.scaling_character: computation/sensing grow sharply with active dimensions; whole-vessel embedding coverage and return conditioning dominate

families.name: Discrete Fold-Jump Drive
families.gravity_behavior: Gravity conditions candidate topology and endpoint covariance; near-gravity folds become increasingly difficult to certify.
families.signature_profile: precommit topology formation, abrupt adjacency event, closure ringing
families.failure_character: endpoint covariance exceedance, occupancy conflict, topology bifurcation, premature commit
families.scaling_character: protected-volume geometry, endpoint covariance, topology field extent, and closure/recovery energy dominate
families.recovery_character: precommit abort is primary; post-event closure/ringing recovery
derived_selection_strengths: little need for continuous en-route steering

families.name: Anchored Wormhole / Gate Transit
families.gravity_behavior: Anchor geometry, mouth state, local curvature, and chronology constraints condition safe aperture operation.
families.signature_profile: persistent aperture field, anchor power, traffic transients, synchronization emissions
families.failure_character: throat instability, mouth desynchronization, asymmetric mass flux, chronology trip, anchor drift, network cascade
families.scaling_character: aperture cross-section, anchor structure, mouth synchronization, thermal/recovery plant, and traffic flux dominate
families.recovery_character: stabilize, isolate, or close throat; paired-mouth response required
derived_selection_strengths: ship carries little or no dedicated FTL machinery

families.name: Quantum Phase Displacement
families.gravity_behavior: Gravity contributes to target-state model uncertainty, reference validity, and target compatibility rather than en-route drag.
families.signature_profile: state preparation, target lock, displacement transient, reconciliation activity
families.failure_character: target aliasing, continuity proof failure, coverage hole, reference poisoning, reconciliation divergence
families.scaling_character: state mapping, whole-object coverage, invariant certification, reference independence, and recovery proof dominate
families.recovery_character: post-arrival state reconciliation and continuity verification

selection_contract.rule: Apply hard admissibility vetoes first. Rank only surviving families/installations. Do not convert ordinal comparison labels into setting-wide numeric performance facts.
hard_vetoes: family unavailable at resolved Path/shared tier
named canon forbids or contradicts family
selection_contract.unknown_policy: Unknowns remain unknown in AUTHORITY_ONLY. LABELED_DERIVATION may compute constrained consequences from confirmed parents. LABELED_PROPOSAL may suggest alternatives but may not overwrite canon.

allowed_relationships: independent primary and emergency transit systems
gate-compatible vessel carrying separate shipboard drive
shared power conditioning where physically compatible
shared sensing/reference infrastructure with independent verification channels
forbidden_inferences: two installed families automatically combine performance
shared power bus makes mechanisms interoperable
same Q vocabulary means Q-Lattice and Slipstream are the same system
Fold-Jump can steer after commit because Metric can
Gate infrastructure grants shipboard gate capability
mixed_installation_rules.shared_support_rules: Shared sensors, clocks, power, cooling, structure, and command systems must preserve family-specific independence requirements. A common-mode failure introduced by sharing must be represented in failure analysis and provenance.

technology_basis_translation.rule: Translate end effects into carrier, manufacturing, service, control, thermal, structural, sensing, and failure embodiments. Never use basis identity as evidence that a race invented, owns, or commonly uses a transit family.

education_and_manual_requirements.operator: teach family-specific commit/abort boundaries, admissibility alarms, recovery reserves, environmental vetoes, and traffic/infrastructure dependencies
education_and_manual_requirements.maintainer: teach whole-installation topology, shared-support common-mode failures, calibration ancestry, signature baselines, and return-to-service proof
education_and_manual_requirements.engineer: teach equations as family-specific models, not universal constants; distinguish confirmed operator from derived mathematical representation
education_and_manual_requirements.generator_author: retain status and provenance at field level; never rank an unknown as though it were a measured value

api_contract.determinism: For identical authority snapshot, generator version, complete inputs, and seed where stochastic tie-breaking is allowed, output must be reproducible.

provenance_guards: Specific named canon outranks comparative defaults.
Derived ordinal comparisons are not universal numeric constants.
Technology basis does not establish race ownership or invention.
Runtime prevalence does not promote generated content to setting canon.
Multiple observations sharing one source ancestor are not independent confirmations.
Training accidents, sample patents, equations, coefficients, and diagrams retain their own status.
Family-specific hard vetoes cannot be averaged away by a global score.

A generated vessel instance may be authoritative only for that instance when complete authority snapshot, resolver choices, scale coordinates, seed hierarchy, generator version, and provenance are retained.
